payload.name: Social contagion of cheating via observation and victimization
payload.fact: The spread of antisocial behavior like cheating in online games is driven by an interaction between third-party observation and direct experience of victimization, a form of pay-it-forward reciprocity.

provenance.title: Cheating in online gaming spreads through observation and victimization
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results reveal that social contagion is only likely to exist for those who both observe and experience cheating, suggesting that third-party influence and “pay-it-forward” reciprocity interact positively
